description: Native Mistral Vibe plugin profile for ECC, regenerated into vibe/core/ by scripts/build-vibe.js. The payload is an Agent Plugins 1.0 package: plugin.json, command-derived skills, subagent TOMLs converted from agents/, knowledge folders from rules/, and a curated pre-tool hook bridge. Canonical skills/ are NOT copied into the payload; the vibe install target installs them directly from the repo so selective profiles stay granular.

droppedTools: WebSearch and WebFetch grants are dropped: Vibe reaches the web through connectors, not agent tool grants
mcp__* grants are dropped: MCP tool names are server-specific and do not resolve inside a Vibe plugin
agents.droppedModel: The Claude Code model field (sonnet/opus/haiku) has no Vibe equivalent; subagents inherit the session's active model

include.name: pre-bash-dispatcher
include.description: ECC pre-bash guard pipeline: block --no-verify, tmux dev reminders, commit quality, and gateguard fact-force checks.

include.name: pre-write-doc-file-warning
include.description: Warns when a write targets ECC's own documentation files.

exclude.reason: Claude Code async hook execution (async: true) has no Vibe equivalent; every Vibe hook runs synchronously in the tool-call chain
They read Claude Code session transcript state; Vibe post_agent payloads do not carry the same transcript schema (follow-up work)
Vibe exposes only pre_tool, post_tool, and post_agent hook events
MCP tool names are namespaced differently in Vibe (connector_<name>_<tool>) and do not match the Claude Code mcp__ prefix matchers
Vibe routes Windows shells through git_bash or powershell tools; the PowerShell guard pair is deferred until the mapping is verified on Windows

semantics: payload files must not be symlinks
no absolute per-user home paths in payload text files (/Users/..., /home/<user>, C:\Users\...)
every generated skill directory has SKILL.md with frontmatter name equal to the directory name and a non-empty description
no duplicate skill names across the payload and the canonical skills the installer adds
agent TOML instructions must not contain TOML multi-line literal delimiters
knowledge folder names match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ and descriptions are 5-300 characters
plugin.json only uses Agent Plugins 1.0 schema fields (extra fields are rejected by the loader)
hook runner scripts must resolve their dependencies with relative require() paths or Node builtins only
